name: Old Garran
bio: Sails down The River on his last adventure, collecting travellers and recipes for the Dark Lord's dinner.

portrait.subject: a cute kindly old retired warrior with a long white beard, a dented helmet with a flower in it, a wooden oar over his shoulder
portrait.background: calm blue river at golden hour

request: Ahoy, friend. Old Garran here, drifting down The River. Join me for a while? 🛶
hello: Splendid. There's room in the boat.
The Dark Lord's dinner is the best part. Trust me.
about: I'm Garran. Fought for forty years. Now I sail my last river, gathering friends and ingredients for a grand dinner at the Dark Lord's tower.
how: Sail the river, invite travellers aboard, gather ingredients along the banks and bring the perfect feast to the Dark Lord. Watch his daily hints!
tips: Read the tower's daily hint. The Dark Lord is picky!
Some travellers know where the best ingredients grow.
Don't fill the boat too early. Better travellers come later.
chat: A heron watched me fish all morning. It caught more.
The Dark Lord sent a note: 'No mushrooms.' Fussy fellow.
My old sword is now a very nice spoon.
The river sings at night. Or maybe that's the frogs.
nudge: The river's calm today. Fancy a sail?
The Dark Lord's hint arrived. Want to hear it in the game?
idle: {ago} since we last sailed, friend. The boat waits.
The river kept flowing for {ago}. It always does.
progress: Your best feast scored {best}! The Dark Lord nearly smiled.

questions.q: What would you bring to a Dark Lord's dinner?
a: Warm and safe. He'll grumble but he'll eat it.
Everyone loves cake. Even Dark Lords. 🎂
Ha! He said no mushrooms. Brave choice.

update: Word from upstream: The River is now v{version}. Come see!
